notes: No more one-word mystery replies. When the model server is busy it can cut an answer after a single word — those stubs are now caught and retried silently before you ever see them. Truncated replies no longer pollute chat history (they were teaching the bot to answer in one word), and old ones are cleaned out on startup.
notes_zh: 不再有一句话的神秘回复。模型服务器繁忙时可能只回一个词就截断——现在这些残缺回复会被识别并在你看到之前自动静默重试。被截断的回复不再污染聊天记忆（它们曾把 bot 教成单词回复），旧记录会在启动时清理。
